note: Set A is more faithful to the numeric values in the text layer, correctly extracting the 4-inch bolt length and 2x8 framing in most claims, whereas Set B hallucinates bolt lengths (4.5", 3") and misattributes dimensions between details (assigning B1 dimensions to C1). Both sets hallucinate a 'pressure treated' or 'treated wood' claim not found in the text (which specifies 'reclaimed wood'), but Set B has more frequent misbindings and fabricated quotes (e.g., '1" SLEEVE' vs '1" NUT'). Set A has fewer factual errors regarding the explicit text values.
